fee_notes: Royalty is 5.25% of Net Billings for non-National Accounts and 6.25% for National Accounts. Marketing fee is greater of $500/month or 2.5% of prior month Net Billings. Tech (Athena Business System) fee is higher of $250/month or 1% of prior month Net Billings. Microsoft Enterprise Package at $14.50/seat/month additional.
raw_excerpt: Royalty/Continuing Fee: (i) 5.25% of monthly Net Billings generated from non-National Accounts and (ii) 6.25% of monthly Net Billings generated from National Accounts. General Marketing Fee: greater of $500 per month or 2.5% of the prior month's Net Billings. Monthly Athena Business System and Email Service Fee: higher of $250 per month or 1% of the prior month's Net Billings.
